text.tspan: Book skilled local workers like electricians,
track jobs; karigars manage requests, profile
The street-corner labour chowk, on a phone.
Employers find daily-wage workers by skill
and location on a live map, and post jobs.
Samagra ID + OTP login, selfie + GPS attendance,
Yoga groups and sessions with QR attendance,
Patwaris report crop damage from the field with
Agri-GIS platform for the Farmer Welfare &
workflows and rover GPS for 29 + 2 logins.
Offline forest-rights survey across range, beat
